title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity fixes + v1.129.0 bumps
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: This PR standardizes authentication semantics, retry/backoff behavior, and streaming API ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. It also includes a set of parity fixes so the SDKs match behavior documented in the API spec and bumps package versions to v1.129.0. Motivation: supporting a single, predictable developer experience when switching SDKs or migrating code paths has been a recurring source of confusion (see ENG-2045). This change reduces surface area differences, harmonizes default retry semantics, and improves streaming ergonomics (consistent iterator/async patterns and unified cancellation semantics).

What changed (high level):
- Auth: introduced a shared credential/provider abstraction for transient credentials and token refresh; consistent env var and config precedence across languages; documented fallback order.
- Retries: standardized default retryable error set, added jittered exponential backoff util shared logic, and made per-client retry policy declarative with clear defaults.
- Streaming: unified streaming API shapes so that Python/TS/Golang clients expose consistent interfaces for chunked reads, partial errors, and end-of-stream semantics; added explicit close/cancel methods and improved context/cancellation propagation.
- Parity fixes: fixed small behavioral differences (header names, error wrapping, metadata propagation) discovered when running cross-language integration tests.
- Version bumps: python/ts/go packages -> v1.129.0 with changelogs.

Testing: unit + integration suites were extended. Cross-language integration test harness exercised auth refresh and streaming cancel scenarios. Manual QA done by SDK owners: opening streams, forcing backend socket closes, validating retries and metrics emitted.

Risk and rollback: All changes are backward-compatible by default; opt-ins are required to change retry policies. If issues are observed we can revert the top-level SDK package bump or flip the feature gate to prior defaults.

Checklist:
- [x] API and docs updated
- [x] Unit tests added/updated
- [x] Integration tests added
- [x] Changelog entries for all three SDKs
- [x] Version bumps committed
commits: feat(sdk-common): add shared credential provider and precedence rules
feat(sdk-retry): implement jittered exp backoff and declarative retry policy
feat(sdk-streaming): unify stream interfaces and add cancel/close helpers
fix(python): header parity and metadata propagation fixes in http client
fix(ts): adjust streaming chunk event ordering to match spec
fix(go): ensure context cancellation closes low-level socket
chore(release): bump python/ts/go sdk versions to v1.129.0 and update changelogs
review_thread:
Evan Lin: Can we tighten the default retryable status codes? Some customers rely on 429 being handled specially.
Aisha: We left 429 in the default set but added clear docs and a per-client policy so callers can opt out. Added a test for 429 throttling.
Priya Desai: In TS streaming the partial-error event ordering looked different from Python — please confirm.
Aisha: Adjusted the TS client to emit partial-error before data chunks to match the canonical spec and added cross-language test.
Carlos Mendieta: Are there any perf regressions from adding credential provider indirection?
Aisha: Benchmarked auth hot path; microbenchmarks show <1% overhead in client instantiation and negligible effect on per-request latency because credential refresh is async and cached. Added note in CHANGELOG.
Wei Zhang (approval): LGTM after addressing TS event ordering and CI flakes.
Maintainer: Squash-merged after green CI and changelog updates.
ci_checks: CI summary: linux-build (pass), python-unit (pass), ts-unit (pass), go-unit (pass), integration-crosslang (pass), lint (initial fail -> fixed and rerun -> pass). One flaky e2e test was muted and tracked under ENG-2120. Total runs: 3. All required checks green before merge.
merge_outcome: Merged into main by devops-bot (Aisha Kapoor listed as author) after approvals and green CI. Release commits pushed for python/ts/go packages.
release_notes:
- SDKs: unify auth provider semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go; added clear precedence order and refresh behavior.
- SDKs: standardized retry defaults and exposed declarative per-client policy with jittered exponential backoff.
- SDKs: unified streaming APIs for consistent chunk/partial-error ordering, cancel/close helpers, and improved context propagation.
- Bugfixes: parity fixes for header names, metadata propagation, and context cancellation across SDKs.
- Version bump: python/ts/go -> v1.129.0
notes_for_qa: Cross-language integration tests in integration-tests/sdk-crosslang were added. QA should: 1) verify token refresh under concurrent requests, 2) verify streaming cancel closes sockets and stops iteration, 3) validate retry behavior for 429 and 5xx scenarios, 4) smoke test example apps in sdks/<lang>/examples.
